title: Names used by batch p1-G02-2 (Tor relays, Shodan InternetDB, offline IP datasets, IP blocklists)

attributes.is_tor_relay: bool: the IP is an address of a running Tor relay (Onionoo running-relay summary or details)
attributes.tor_relay: list of Tor relay facts for the IP from Onionoo {nickname, fingerprint, flags, running, first_seen, last_seen, asn, as_name, country, exit} (operator contact fields are never kept)
attributes.tor_exit_history: list of dated Tor exit answers {date, source, state, text, observed_first, observed_last, fingerprints}: 'was an exit on <date>, CollecTor', relay periods from the mthcht history, or 'history not downloaded'
attributes.dataset_age: list of 'dataset, fetched YYYY-MM-DD (age)' lines for the local datasets an offline answer used
attributes.network_type: network class of the AS: 'eyeball', 'hosting', 'transit' or 'unknown' (bgp.tools class mapping)
attributes.as_class: bgp.tools class label of the AS ('Eyeball', 'Content', 'Carrier', 'Unknown')
attributes.as_country: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country the AS is registered in (IPtoASN / bgp.tools), not a geolocation
attributes.announced: bool: the address lies in a BGP-announced range (IPtoASN 'Not routed' = false)
attributes.ip_range: address range 'first-last' that contains the IP in the source dataset
attributes.as_range_count: number of dataset ranges announced by the AS (IPtoASN)
attributes.as_ipv4_addresses: number of IPv4 addresses in the ranges announced by the AS (IPtoASN)
attributes.continent: continent code of the IP (offline geolocation database; country-level context only)
attributes.in_eu: bool: the country of the IP is in the European Union (offline geolocation database)
attributes.blocklist_hits: list of local blocklist hits {feed, name, family, listed_at, feed_age, currency, stale, fidelity, provenance {feed, fetched_at, sha256}, attribution, terms, restricted}
attributes.blocklist_families: independent upstream families that list the entity (consensus votes: aggregates count as the families they embed)
attributes.ipsum_count: number of public blocklists that list the IP according to IPsum
attributes.shared_ip: bool: CDN / shared-edge / shared-hosting address (reputation capped, co-hosted names are not the target)
attributes.verdict_lifetime_days: days a reputation verdict on this address stays valid (IaaS addresses are reassigned)
attributes.tls_self_signed: bool: a TLS service on the host presents a self-signed certificate (scanner tag)
attributes.eol_software: bool: end-of-life product or OS observed on the host (scanner tag, version-inferred)
attributes.is_honeypot: bool: the scanner classifies the host as a honeypot
attributes.is_ics: bool: industrial control system protocol exposed (scanner tag)
attributes.is_scanner: bool: the address is classified as an internet scanner by the source
attributes.internetdb_status: Shodan InternetDB answer state: 'seen' or 'not seen by Shodan scanners' (404 'No information available', never 'no open ports')

tags.anonymizer: anonymity infrastructure (Tor exit, anonymizing proxy): traffic from many users, no attribution possible - context, never malicious on its own
tags.blocklisted: listed on downloadable IP/ASN/certificate blocklists matched locally (see blocklist_hits for feeds and dates)
tags.hijacked_netblock: inside a netblock or AS that Spamhaus DROP/ASN-DROP lists as hijacked or operated by criminals
